reuse.why: Routes every planning path through the existing getScheduledAmount and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the tolerance instead of recomputing 7.5%.

duplication.why: Removes five inline midpoint copies (preview, two in schedules/app, forecast, schedule template) in favour of the shared helper and adds none.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside the amount helpers; the API field is computed in the API handler from the same helper.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the amount rule, its consumers, the API field and their tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: A single definition now decides the expected amount everywhere, though callers pass the op behind a positional `false`, the list return type is an inline intersection rather than a named API model, and the Balance comment and one release note still describe the superseded 'furthest from zero' rule.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All planning consumers call getScheduledAmount; none keeps its own range or approx arithmetic.

disguised_duplication.where: Former inline copies were removed, not reshaped; the approx tolerance delegates to getApproxNumberThreshold.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains one `op` parameter for approximate amounts and delegates to two small named helpers; the five sites that previously bypassed it were converted to call it.
